svg.aria-label: AgentRQ task scheduling: you give a task a cadence, every 15 minutes, and click Save. A poller ticks every minute while five agents, claude, codex, agy, hermes and openclaw, sleep; when a scheduled task comes due its row flashes and a run flies down to its agent, which wakes, works and finishes, and the next run rolls forward.

svg.text: Dates and cadences, nobody waiting up.
